QuestInfo.name: The New Ally
QuestInfo.0: It seems #b#p2151005##k has something to say to you. Talk to #p2151005# in #b#m310010010##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2151005# reports she is now better and wants to join the Resistance. She wants to pay back the people who rescued her.
QuestInfo.2: #p2151005# became a new ally of the Resistance.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. #p2151005#, who you rescued, has made a full recovery! And we've also decided what to do about her...
0.1: We're going to look after her! Yes, the Resistance has its own little ward now. We wanted to return her to her family, but she has no recollection of life before the lab. And she can't live in town because the Black Wings would recognize her.
0.2: So, #b#p2151005# will stay at the Underground Base from now on#k. Why don't you go over and say hi?

yes.0: #p2151005# seems to really like you, probably because you saved her. Be kind to her. She can't take even a single step outside our base until every last member of the Black Wings has been vanquished.

no.0: Oh, are you busy training? Well, if you could spare the time, I think you should go see her at the Underground Base. She really misses you.

1.0: Hey, #h0#! Did you hear? I'm part of the Resistance now! And it's not just because I have nowhere else to go, okay? I really want to be here! I want to do everything in my power to help you!

yes.0: But I'm worried I won't be much help. I'm too weak to fight, and I can't wander around collecting intel. To top it off, I have no money. But...can I tell you something?

npc.0: You haven't gone to see #p2151005#? She's right over there. Don't be shy...
